keyword.en: low pressure 40 vs electric 40 concrete pump
keyword.zh: 电动低压40和电动40的区别

title.en: Low Pressure 40 vs Electric 40 Concrete Pump
title.zh: 电动低压40和电动40混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: The low-pressure name and the Electric 40 name are different rows: 37 kW against 45 kW, and 20 MPa against 23 MPa.
description.zh: 「低压」名称和电动40是不同的行：37 kW 对 45 kW，20 MPa 对 23 MPa。

h1.en: Low Pressure 40 vs Electric 40 Concrete Pump
h1.zh: 电动低压40和电动40混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: Electric Low Pressure 40 and Electric 40 are separate concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Low Pressure 40 prints 37 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa and fine-stone 80 m / 240 m. Electric 40 prints 45 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, fine-stone 120 m / 360 m and an aggregate-13 row of 40 m / 120 m. Both name a Kawasaki 112. The name does not override the pressure cell.
directAnswer.zh: 电动低压40和电动40是河北品锦机械在邢台的两台混凝土泵。低压40印 37 kW、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、细石 80 m / 240 m。电动40印 45 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、细石 120 m / 360 m，以及 13 骨料 40 m / 120 m。两边都写川崎112。名称不能覆盖压力格。

heading.en: Where Electric Low Pressure 40 and Electric 40 print different values
heading.zh: 电动低压40和电动40哪些数值不同

body.en: Motor power: Electric Low Pressure 40 prints 37 kW; Electric 40 prints 45 kW. Theoretical output: Electric Low Pressure 40 prints 12–15 m³/h; Electric 40 prints 21 m³/h. Max. outlet pressure: Electric Low Pressure 40 prints 20 MPa; Electric 40 prints 23 MPa. Hopper capacity: Electric Low Pressure 40 prints 0.3 m³; Electric 40 prints 0.4 m³. Fine-stone pumping (H / V): Electric Low Pressure 40 prints 80 m / 240 m; Electric 40 prints 120 m / 360 m. Dimensions: Electric Low Pressure 40 prints 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm; Electric 40 prints 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm. The same printed value on a shared label: Hydraulic pump is Kawasaki 112 on both pages. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 电机功率：电动低压40印 37 kW；电动40印 45 kW。理论输送量：电动低压40印 12–15 m³/h；电动40印 21 m³/h。最大出口压力：电动低压40印 20 MPa；电动40印 23 MPa。料斗容积：电动低压40印 0.3 m³；电动40印 0.4 m³。细石输送（水平/垂直）：电动低压40印 80 m / 240 m；电动40印 120 m / 360 m。外形尺寸：电动低压40印 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm；电动40印 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm。同一标题下数值相同的有：液压泵两边都是 Kawasaki 112。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Electric 40 prints cells that Electric Low Pressure 40 does not: Aggregate-13 pumping (H / V) 40 m / 120 m. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 电动40有、电动低压40没有的行：13骨料输送（水平/垂直） 40 m / 120 m。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: Calling one row low pressure does not mean its 20 MPa cell can be swapped with the 23 MPa cell. Open /en/products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump/ for Electric Low Pressure 40 and /en/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/ for Electric 40. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 一行名叫低压，并不表示它的 20 MPa 可以和另一行的 23 MPa 对调。看电动低压40请打开 /zh/products/electric-low-pressure-40-concrete-pump/，看电动40请打开 /zh/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Electric Low Pressure 40 print the same motor power as Electric 40?
question.zh: 电动低压40和电动40的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric Low Pressure 40 prints 37 kW. Electric 40 prints 45 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动低压40印 37 kW。电动40印 45 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric Low Pressure 40 print the same theoretical output as Electric 40?
question.zh: 电动低压40和电动40的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric Low Pressure 40 prints 12–15 m³/h. Electric 40 prints 21 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动低压40印 12–15 m³/h。电动40印 21 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric Low Pressure 40 print the same max. outlet pressure as Electric 40?
question.zh: 电动低压40和电动40的最大出口压力一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric Low Pressure 40 prints 20 MPa. Electric 40 prints 23 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动低压40印 20 MPa。电动40印 23 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Where is the aggregate-13 pumping (h / v) for Electric 40 printed?
question.zh: 电动40的13骨料输送（水平/垂直）印在哪里？

answer.en: It is printed on /en/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/ as 40 m / 120 m. It is not printed as that label on the Electric Low Pressure 40 page.
answer.zh: 印在 /zh/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/，数值为 40 m / 120 m。电动低压40页面没有这个标题。
